inventories.scope: The store of kept records acts as an origin server for conditional requests only, and RFC 9110 section 2.2 sets conformance by the role a participant takes: entity tags and their comparison, the If-Match and If-None-Match preconditions, their evaluation, and the status codes the store answers with.

rfc9110-13.1.2-f6759583.how: http-tests/cache-tests conditional-etag-weak-respond (a held ETag W/"abcdef" and a received If-None-Match W/"abcdef" answer 304) with RFC 9110 Table 3 (the same pair is no match by the strong function and a match by the weak one): respond answers 304, so the weak function is the one used; prismpm build runs every acceptance vector of the records guest (app/specs/records/spec.json, written from the RFC's table and the suite's file by generators/transition's storetable, storecache and storevectors), and tools/guests/gen.py check holds its wasm to the build
